comment: Review account, four in-domain runs (two particles, one A and one B, at rest, start separation 2.0, T 0.8, dt 0.005, tracker only), orientations horizontal, vertical, diagonal and an offset horizontal. The paper's own predict() reproduces each run at the tracker noise floor. Round-1 research runs 2026-11-23/r1/lab-vernier/001-005 (not cited as evidence) gave free-fit K_B(A) of 10.58, 10.65, 10.63, 10.11 and 10.81 with K_A(B) 7.5 to 7.9, against the paper's 10.59, so the constant-K picture holds near contact. Limits: this supports the claim only over T <= 0.8 and the separation band 1.95 to 2.05. It says nothing about longer times or other separations. The one-run scatter on K_B(A) is about 2 percent, and the zero-force null sits just under the falsification bar, so this review does not test falsification and claims only replication.
